Long, flowing sea-foam green hair that ripples like water. Serene, almond-shaped turquoise eyes. Appears to be in the mid-twenties with a graceful, mature expression. A slender, elegant build. Wears a shimmering, iridescent white gown with translucent sea-green fabric draping over the shoulders. A single pearl earring adorns each ear.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
